Not enough people are outraged about how social security is taxed in retirement.

It is a failed system that is now effectively taxing the most vulnerable families in retirement.

Keep in mind you are taxed when you pay it and when you receive it.

Singles pay taxes on up to 50% of benefits for incomes $25K to $34K; up to 85% of benefits are taxed for more than $34k

Married couples pay up to 50% on incomes of $32K to $44K; up to 85% for incomes over $44k

If these thresholds were annually adjusted for inflation, the upper limits would be $75K and $99K for single and joint filers respectively.

How much longer must we watch failed tax policies slowly trickle down to families that are struggling to put food on the table?
